description: Makes, or returns the existing, public link for a saved quote: the page where the customer's client can view and approve it, and pay online when allow_payment is on. The link never changes once made. It sends nothing (email_quote does). Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

allow_payment.description: Let the recipient pay online from the link. Omit to keep the quote's current setting (off for a new link).

quote.description: The quote number (or the quote id from its link).

name: share_quote
title: Get a quote's public link
